title: The Survivor's Cache
text: Under a flat stone by a split tree, hidden the way your House teaches, lies a cache: food wrapped in oilcloth, a dagger, a note in your House's cipher. The handwriting is shaky. The last line is pressed so hard it tore the paper.

options.label: The cleverest reads the cipher to learn what became of them.

outcomes.text: The note says where they went to ground, and what to beware of.

options.label: Eat, and leave something in return, as your House would want.

outcomes.text: The food gives you strength for the road. You leave coin for them in case they come back this way.

options.label: The Leader takes all of it; they will not need it if you find them first.
